text: Explain the recruitment and training of the judiciary. Consider whether the training of judges is
adequate. [25]
Describe the legislative process in Parliament. What are the advantages and disadvantages of
making law in this way? [25]
Explain the various aims of sentencing and evaluate how far the types of sentence available for
adults reflect each aim. [25]
The doctrine of precedent offers guidelines but very few strict rules.
Explain how precedent works in the English legal system and consider to what extent the above
statement is true. [25]
Explain the pre trial matters which apply to a defendant charged with a triable either way offence.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of being tried in the Magistrates’ Court. [25]
Describe the selection process for jurors. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using a
lay person for this role. [25]
